content: Mobile UX for image-heavy sites: declare width/height or CSS aspect-ratio on every image to reserve space (dominant cause of CLS); never loading=lazy on the hero/LCP image, use it below the fold; srcset+sizes cuts image payload 80-90% but needs multi-size assets; placeholder strategies ranked by cost (dominant-color hex, tiny LQIP, CSS skeleton shimmer, BlurHash); target size >=24x24 CSS px (WCAG 2.2 AA 2.5.8), 44-48px recommended for touch; vertical scrolling is the natural mobile lookbook pattern; one idea per screen; minimal text.
